text: dsh-whale-animation 是面向 DSH Web 的鲸鱼动画插件，在状态栏位置显示两套内嵌动画，并按思考状态文字选择 Dive 或 Classic 循环。它通过浏览器客户端监视状态节点，等待当前动画循环结束后再切换；页面隐藏时暂停扫描，恢复可见后刷新。插件支持深色主题、响应式尺寸和减少动态效果偏好，相关图片离线内嵌，不需要 API 密钥或额外账号。适合希望为 DSH Web 状态提示添加鲸鱼动效的用户。

dsh-whale-animation adds two whale loops to the DSH Web status area. It chooses Dive or Classic from status text and switches after each loop. Hidden tabs pause scanning; visible tabs refresh. It supports dark themes and reduced motion. Embedded assets work offline with no key or account required.
想让 DSH Web 的状态提示显示鲸鱼动画。
能不能在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里加一个会循环播放的鲸鱼状态图？
让状态文字为思考或推理时显示对应的鲸鱼动效。
浏览器切到后台后暂停状态动画扫描，回来再继续更新。
Add an animated whale indicator to the DSH Web status area.
Show different whale loops based on the current reasoning status text.
dsh-whale-animation 的功能「循环播放两套动画」：状态节点出现后默认从 Dive 开始，再按完整循环切换到 Classic；切换时间依据各自循环时长。
dsh-whale-animation 的功能「根据状态文字选动画」：状态文字匹配思考、推理或分析关键词时选择 Dive，匹配 classic 或原版别名时选择 Classic。
dsh-whale-animation 的功能「尊重减少动态效果」：浏览器启用 prefers-reduced-motion 时采用对应静态状态，并停止动画循环计时。
dsh-whale-animation 的功能「隐藏标签页暂停并恢复」：页面变为隐藏时释放当前动画资源并暂停计时，恢复可见时重新扫描状态节点。
dsh-whale-animation 的功能「清理浏览器生命周期资源」：效果卸载时移除监听器、观察器、定时器、样式和插件创建的对象 URL。
给网页里的 DSH 状态提示换成鲸鱼动画，并支持减少动态效果。
Give my DSH Web status indicator a whale animation that respects reduced motion.

dsh-whale-animation README · dsh-whale-animation：Two original whale animations for DeepSeek Harness Web. Nothing else. v0.7.1 supports DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 without the retired, unused client-runtime injection. Background tabs pause document polling and refresh immediately when visible. Windows and Linux build the same LF-normalized client, checked by both CI platforms. | Refined Dive | Classic | |---|---| | | |

dsh-whale-animation README · Scope：- **Refined Dive**: restored from commit `65e1205d1fbf4b01997e6dfc099103b0f9717e37`.
- **Classic**: restored from first-published commit `95b06e3f0e6ea817d25858eb29f7064a233b3c65`.
- Both animated WebPs and both reduced-motion PNGs are verified by Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256, frame count, and timing.
- The director plays one full Dive loop (1.980 s), then one full Classic loop (10.506 s). Status-text requests also wait for the current loop to finish.
- An unambiguous status-node replacement under the same parent preserves its current loop and deadline. Across parents, playback is inherited only when a single DOM mutation records the replacement of the containing subtree; separate removal/insertion records start independent playback. An update with no status ends that playback session.
- Dark theme, 84/72/60 px responsive sizing, reduced-motion PNGs, offline embedding, and lifecycle cleanup remain supported.
dsh-whale-animation README · Scope：Removed in v0.7.0: Spout, Sonar, Tool Run, Stream, Calm, Retry, all generated art sources, and their build pipeline.

dsh-whale-animation README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
```

Restart DSH or hard-refresh DSH Web after upgrading.

dsh-whale-animation README · Verify：```powershell
npm run verify
npm run check:browser
npm pack --dry-run
```

`npm run verify` regenerates only `assets/manifest.json` and `lib/client.js`; it never regenerates or re-encodes either original animation.

Release publication also runs the Chromium browser smoke test and stops if it fails.

On Windows, run `check:browser` with Git Bash on `PATH` and set `CHROME_BIN` to the Chrome executable when Chrome is not on `PATH`.

dsh-whale-animation README · Runtime contract：| Property | Refined Dive | Classic |
|---|---:|---:|
| Canvas | 352 × 352 | 184 × 184 |
| Frames | 60 | 618 |
| Frame duration | 33 ms | 17 ms |
| Loop duration | 1.980 s | 10.506 s |
| Source | byte-preserved | byte-preserved |

dsh-whale-animation README · dsh-whale-animation：DeepSeek Harness Web 鲸鱼插件现在只保留两套原始动画，不再包含任何新增美术状态。 v0.7.1 已适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1：移除了新版已不再提供、插件本身也未使用的旧 client-runtime 依赖。后台标签页暂停页面扫描，恢复可见时立即更新。Windows 与 Linux 构建现在使用相同的 LF 输出，并由双平台 CI 检查。 | Refined Dive | Classic | |---|---| | | |

dsh-whale-animation README · 范围：- **Refined Dive**：来自提交 `65e1205d1fbf4b01997e6dfc099103b0f9717e37`。
- **Classic**：来自首发提交 `95b06e3f0e6ea817d25858eb29f7064a233b3c65`。
- 两个 WebP 和两个减少动态效果 PNG 均校验 Git Blob SHA-1、SHA-256、帧数和时序。
- 按 `dive → classic` 播放完整循环：Dive 1.980 秒，Classic 10.506 秒。状态文字要求切换时，也先播完当前循环。
- 同一父容器中能明确对应的新旧状态节点沿用当前循环及切换时间。跨父容器时，必须由一条 DOM 变更记录证明包含它们的子树被直接替换；分别删除和新增的节点独立起播。页面更新后没有状态节点时结束本轮播放。
- 保留深色主题、84/72/60 px 响应式尺寸、减少动态效果、离线内嵌与完整生命周期清理。

v0.7.0 已删除：Spout、Sonar、Tool Run、Stream、Calm、Retry、全部生成美术源图及其构建链。

dsh-whale-animation README · 安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
```

升级后请重启 DSH，或对 DSH Web 强制刷新。

dsh-whale-animation README · 验证：```powershell
npm run verify
npm run check:browser
npm pack --dry-run
```

`npm run verify` 只重建 `assets/manifest.json` 与 `lib/client.js`，绝不会重新生成或重新编码两套原始动画。

Release 发布还会执行 Chromium 浏览器烟测；烟测失败时停止发布。

Windows 上运行 `check:browser` 时，需要将 Git Bash 加入 `PATH`；Chrome 不在 `PATH` 中时，通过 `CHROME_BIN` 指定其可执行文件。

安装了 Python Playwright 和 Chrome 的开发机还可运行 `npm run check:playback`，实测完整轮换时长、后台恢复、主题和减少动态效果。详细记录见 [2026-09-05 兼容与播放验收](docs/compatibility-20260905.md)。
